facts.fact: The Minister of State Domains says the national land office (ONPF) has finished installing its comprehensive IT system for its services and rolled it out to all its regional offices.

systems.system: ONPF IT system and cpf.gov.tn site
systems.owner: Office National de la Propriété Foncière

note: No electronic processing of transactions stated; e-signature for transfers is not yet launched.

facts.fact: Managers reports a Tunis workshop on advisory services for setting up the Tunisian Land Information System (TLIS), whose components include a digital land database, simpler registration and scanning of land archives.

systems.owner: Ministry of Equipment and Housing / OTC

facts.fact: La Presse reports the minister of state domains said the cadastral geoportal, built with the survey and cadastre office (OTC) and the national cartography centre (CNCT), should be finalised within two years to locate state properties and update their data.

systems.owner: Ministry of State Domains and Land Affairs
